scenes.setting: Terms set with a thousand-pound deposit and delivery under Utravsky's enormous shadow; then Emlyn, drowning, asks about praying to 'the evil god The Fool' — and warns why the Primordial Moon must never be prayed to, telling of a Sanguine who became a breeding thing that spawned whole Monster species
scenes.text_anchor: “…have you heard of an evil god known as The Fool?”

scenes.setting: Outside under the misty sky, the ingredient plan: Little Sun repaid in Rampager-purification knowledge, the Naga hair left to the Hanged Man, and the Human-skinned Shadow his own problem — so tonight, worker's clothes in East Borough and a visit to the Bravehearts Bar for Sharron and Maric
scenes.text_anchor: I’ll go visit it in the evening and see if I can contact Miss Sharron and Maric

scenes.setting: Grimm Cemetery in veiled black: flowers laid for Lawrence under the epitaph 'he's a good teacher' — 'How ironic…' — while Fors frets over the Spirit Eater's stomach pouch, until Dorian asks whether she wants to become the kind of Beyonder he described in his letters
scenes.text_anchor: “Fors, do you want to become a Beyonder?
